project_name: STREET KINGS – Don't take the heat.
theme: Concrete Street Gangster / Crime-Noir with Electric Neon Accents & Asphalt Texture
context_type: Gaming / Underground Card Game (Web & Mobile Hybrid)

design_intent.emotional_tone: Gritty, tactile crime-noir, street underworld tension, cinematic command center, neon-lit rainy asphalt
design_intent.metaphor: Wet asphalt streets of Berlin/Hamburg underworld illuminated by flashing police beacons, yellow sodium streetlights, toxic green stash marks, and cyan surveillance monitors.
design_intent.anti_slop_commitment: No generic fantasy purple coven styling. No plain gradients. Distinct tactile concrete grain, industrial stencil typography, stencil cuts, gritty crime dossier panels, sharp neon-edged cards.

headline_display.name: Barlow Condensed
headline_display.style: Heavyweight industrial condensed sans with aggressive street attitude; tracking-tight to tracking-tighter

body_font.name: Chivo
body_font.style: Punchy, authoritative neo-grotesk with bold crime dossier clarity (replaces Cormorant Garamond)

secondary_editorial.name: Cinzel Decorative / Anton / Barlow
secondary_editorial.note: Re-map .font-serif-fancy to Chivo or Barlow Condensed (with italic styling) so that all lingering gothic/witch serif text switches cleanly to street gangster voice

monospace_data.name: JetBrains Mono
monospace_data.style: Police radio dispatch / dossier serial codes / scoring tables

wizard.label: Laufjunge
wizard.rule_summary: Wert 0, bedient nie Farbe, gewinnt nie

asphalt_concrete_bg.formula: background: radial-gradient(1200px 700px at 50% -10%, rgba(239,68,68,0.12), transparent 50%), radial-gradient(900px 600px at 85% 105%, rgba(0,229,255,0.08), transparent 55%), radial-gradient(800px 500px at 15% 95%, rgba(250,204,21,0.06), transparent 50%), #0d0f13; background-image: radial-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,0.04) 1px, transparent 1px), radial-gradient(rgba(0,0,0,0.6) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: 100% 100%, 8px 8px, 16px 16px;

asphalt_noise_overlay.formula: High-contrast asphalt speckle texture using inline SVG feTurbulence with feColorMatrix creating gritty street aggregate particles (opacity 0.075, mix-blend-mode: overlay, pointer-events: none, fixed inset-0 z-50)

crime_dossier_panel.formula: background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(23, 26, 33, 0.88), rgba(15, 17, 22, 0.94)); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); box-shadow: 0 12px 36px rgba(0,0,0,0.65), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.06); backdrop-filter: blur(16px);

concrete_card_surface.formula: Multi-layer CSS with raw concrete grain (repeating subtle noise), 1px interior chiseled bevel (inset 0 1px 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.15)), dark asphalt gradient body, and ultra-crisp neon contour glow on the outer stroke.

frame_structure.background: Deep textured asphalt gradient + subtle aggregate noise
frame_structure.center_visual: Large semi-transparent suit or gangster icon (strokeWidth 1.4 - 1.8) with neon drop-shadow; NO generic photos
frame_structure.top_left_pip: Heavyweight font-display numeral (Barlow Condensed 900) + suit icon stacked vertically
frame_structure.bottom_right_pip: Rotated 180° numeral + suit icon (hidden on xs)
frame_structure.fire_siren_badge: On plain red cards (Hitze), top-right emergency badge with Siren icon + pulse glow
frame_structure.bottom_banner: For special cards: Crime dossier tape / hazard stripe aesthetic with special title (KINGPIN, FIXER, INFORMANT, SCHMIERER, PATIN, LAUFJUNGE) and stat modifier in monospace font-mono-stat

micro_animations.police_strobe: @keyframes police-strobe { 0%, 100% { opacity: 0.9; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 10px #EF4444); } 50% { opacity: 0.4; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 2px #EF4444); } }
micro_animations.asphalt_flicker: @keyframes neon-buzz { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; } 92% { opacity: 0.94; } 94% { opacity: 0.75; } 96% { opacity: 1; } 98% { opacity: 0.82; } }
micro_animations.card_play_arc: framer-motion spring animation launching from player seat into central trick area with subtle tilt/rotation (-6deg to +6deg) and sweep animation upon trick collection

buttons.primary_action: Heavyweight Barlow Condensed uppercase, tracking-wider, high-contrast neon trigger (Amber/Red street blaze) with dark void text, concrete beveled border, hover:scale-[1.02] active:scale-[0.98]
buttons.secondary_action: Matte dark asphalt panel (bg-black/50) with 1px granite border (border-white/15), hover:border-amber-400/60, hover:text-white

avatar_badge.style: Concrete coin / steel street badge with glowing colored inner rim, Lucide role icon (Crown, Banknote, Car, Package, Laptop, Briefcase), and active player neon ring

score_trackers.heat_gauge: Progress bar from 0 to 70 Hitze. Graded from Caution Yellow (#FACC15) to Tactical Red (#EF4444) with danger stripes when exceeding 50 Hitze.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Replace Google Fonts in index.css with Barlow Condensed, Chivo, and JetBrains Mono. Set font-display to 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif and font-sans to 'Chivo', sans-serif.

2. Update index.css variables and classes: redefine .coven-bg to asphalt/street background with concrete aggregate; redefine .panel to crime dossier glass panel; redefine .gold-text and .glow-ring to neon street aesthetic; add .police-flash and .neon-border classes.

3. Update SUITS in /app/frontend/src/game/constants.js: change RED icon from 'flame' to 'siren' (Hitze), BLUE icon to 'banknote' (Cash), GREEN icon to 'package' (Ware), YELLOW icon to 'mask' (Schwarzmarkt). Keep the four colors red/blue/green/yellow but shift to punchy street neon tones.

4. Update SPECIAL_ICON and SUIT_ICON in CardView.jsx: use Siren for RED, Banknote for BLUE, Package for GREEN, VenetianMask or ShieldAlert for YELLOW. For specials: fire = Crown (Kingpin), water = Handshake (Fixer), earth = Eye (Informant), air = Coins (Schmierer), pygmy = Gem (Patin), wizard = Footprints (Laufjunge).
5. Refactor CardView.jsx to render concrete asphalt texture, neon inner border, sharp bevels, street-tape special banner at bottom, and top-right siren badge for Red cards without any AI images.
6. Clean all remaining coven/witch words from components (replace any witch references in German with Gangster, Crew, Unterwelt, Kodex, Akte).
7. Ensure every interactive button and score card has valid data-testid attributes.
